<p>We&#x27;re thrilled to present Grok 4 Fast, our latest advancement in cost-efficient reasoning models. Built on xAI’s learnings from Grok 4, Grok 4 Fast delivers frontier-level performance across Enterprise and Consumer domains—with exceptional token efficiency. This model pushes the boundaries for smaller and faster AI, making high-quality reasoning accessible to more users and developers. Grok 4 Fast features state-of-the-art (SOTA) cost-efficiency, cutting-edge web and X search capabilities, a 2M token context window, and a unified architecture that blends <code>reasoning</code> and <code>non-reasoning</code> modes in one model.</p>
<h2 id="advancing-cost-efficient-intelligence"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#advancing-cost-efficient-intelligence">Advancing Cost-Efficient Intelligence</a></h2>
<p>Grok 4 Fast sets a new frontier in cost-efficient intelligence, outperforming Grok 3 Mini across reasoning benchmarks while slashing token costs.</p>

<h2 id="native-tool-use-with-sota-search"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#native-tool-use-with-sota-search">Native Tool Use with SOTA Search</a></h2>
<p>Grok 4 Fast was trained end-to-end with tool-use reinforcement learning (RL). It excels at deciding when to invoke tools like code execution or web browsing.</p>
<p>For instance, Grok 4 Fast exhibits frontier agentic search capabilities, seamlessly browsing the web and X to augment queries with real-time data. It hops through links, ingests media (including images and videos on X), and synthesizes findings at light speed.</p>

<h2 id="frontier-of-general-post-training"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#frontier-of-general-post-training">Frontier of General Post-training</a></h2>
<p>Grok 4 Fast also establishes a new cost-effective frontier on general domain. We are excited to share Grok 4 Fast’s result on LMArena, where it has been privately battle-testing on the Search and Text Arenas.</p>
<p>In LMArena&#x27;s <a href="https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/search">Search Arena</a>, <code>grok-4-fast-search</code> (code name: <code>menlo</code>) claims <em><em><strong>#1</strong></em></em> with <em><em><strong>1163</strong></em></em> Elo — a commanding margin of <em><em><strong>17</strong></em></em> over <code>o3-search</code>. Its superior reasoning efficiency and intelligence density enable it to surpass much larger models on real-world, search-related tasks.</p>

<p>In LMArena&#x27;s <a href="https://lmarena.ai/leaderboard/text">Text Arena</a>, <code>grok-4-fast</code> (code name: <code>tahoe</code>) ranks <em><em><strong>#8</strong></em></em>, performing on par with <code>grok-4-0709</code> and highlighting its remarkable intelligence density. prose-pre:max-w-xl prose-pre:no-scrollbar [&amp;_h1]:!mt-2 [&amp;_h2]:!mt-2"><p><b>4,250,334,444</b></p><p>In Path of Exile 2, the maximum character level is 100, which requires a total of 4,250,334,444 experience points (XP) to reach from level 1. This value is the cumulative<!-- -->sum of XP needed for each level-up, based on the game&#x27;s fixed experience table (identical to the original Path of Exile). After reaching level 100, additional XP can still be earned but does not grant further levels or meaningful progression.</p><p>To arrive at this total, the game&#x27;s experience system uses a predefined table where each<!-- -->level requires progressively more XP. The &quot;total XP&quot; for level 100 is the sum of all XP<!-- -->thresholds from level 1 to 100. Here&#x27;s how it&#x27;s calculated step by step:</p><ol><li><strong>Understand the XP structure:</strong> Each level has an XP requirement to advance to the next (e.g., level 1 to 2 requires 525 XP). The total for a given level is the running sum of these requirements up to that point. Level 1 starts at 0 XP.</li><li><strong>Reference the experience table:</strong> The official Path of Exile 2 data sources provide the full table. For example:<ul><li>Level 2: 525 total XP (525 to gain from level 1).</li><li>Level 3: 1,760 total XP (1,235 to gain from level 2).</li><li>...and so on, up to level 100.</li></ul></li><li><b>Sum the requirements:</b> Add up the XP needed for all 99 level-ups (from 1 to<!-- -->100). This can be computed programmatically or from the table&#x27;s cumulative values, yielding 4,250,334,444.</li></ol></div></div></div></div>
<h2 id="unified-model-reasoning-and-non-reasoning"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#unified-model-reasoning-and-non-reasoning">Unified Model: Reasoning and Non-Reasoning</a></h2>
<p>Previously, separate reasoning modes required distinct models. Grok 4 Fast introduces a unified architecture where <code>reasoning</code> (long chain-of-thought) and <code>non-reasoning</code> (quick responses) are handled by the same model weights, steered via system prompts. This unification reduces end-to-end latency as well as token costs, making Grok 4 Fast ideal for real-time applications.</p>
<p>In <a href="http://grok.com/?q=What%20is%20the%20answer%20to%20life,%20the%20universe,%20and%20everything?&amp;m=7">grok.com</a>, this results in smooth transitions: responding instantly for simple queries or engaging in extended reasoning for complex ones. In the xAI API, developers can fine-tune this behavior, optimizing for speed or depth.</p>

<p>Grok 4 Fast is available now for all users. In <code>Fast</code> and <code>Auto</code> modes, you will see a significant improvement in search and information seeking queries. Additionally, difficult queries in <code>Auto</code> mode will use Grok 4 Fast, which will provide a much faster experience without loss of quality. For the first time, all users, including free users, will have access to our latest model without restrictions, marking a step toward democratizing advanced AI.</p>
<h2 id="grok-4-fast-on-openrouter-vercel-ai-gateway-and-the-xai-api"><a class="heading-anchor" href="#grok-4-fast-on-openrouter-vercel-ai-gateway-and-the-xai-api">Grok 4 Fast on OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, and the xAI API</a></h2>
<p>We&#x27;re rolling out Grok 4 Fast as two models: <code>grok-4-fast-reasoning</code> and <code>grok-4-fast-non-reasoning</code>, each with a 2M token context window. This allows developers to tune the amount of test-time compute applied to their use cases.</p>
<p><code>grok-4-fast-reasoning</code> and <code>grok-4-fast-non-reasoning</code> are generally available via the <a href="https://x.ai/api">xAI API</a> according to the following pricing:</p>
